en.title: Substrings Where the Number of Zeros Equals the Square of the Number of Ones
en.description:
Count the non-empty contiguous binary substrings in which the number of 0s is exactly the square of the number of 1s.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, examples, and judging.
en.input: A single line containing a binary string of length 1..100000.
en.explanation: Example 1: the two adjacent 01, the one adjacent 10, and the whole string (two 1s and four 0s) are valid, 4 in total. Example 2: with only 0s the condition cannot hold, so the answer is 0. Example 3: one 0 and one 1 satisfy 1=1², so the answer is 1.
hints: If there are k ones, the substring length must be k²+k. Enumerate every k≥1 for which this length is ≤n, and check all windows of that fixed length using prefix sums of the 1s.
